key: SRM Current Controller with PWM Generation
title: SRM Current Controller with PWM Generation
text: Current controller with internal pulse width modulation for switched reluctance machines, 6 inputs, 1 output, {Carrier counter} sets Carrier counter model; {Proportional gain} sets the controller proportional gain, K p, {Integral gain}, {Anti-windup gain}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Timer period (s)} sets the pWM timer period and {Fundamental sample time (s)} sets the sample time for PWM generation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: Controller proportional gain, K p 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: Integral gain, K i 5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Anti-windup gain
params.values: Anti-windup gain, K aw 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Carrier counter
params.values: Carrier counter model Up (default) | Down | Up-Down

params.name: Fundamental sample time (s)
params.values: Sample time for PWM generation 0.0001 (default) | positive scalar
